items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: when we was with Freddie and also Joe Rubin, she always had a chance to play some drums.

ctx.x: Is there any special reason why you like trombone, why you finally settled on that? It's a wonderful instrument and then of course you can say that all of them.
I had a, I'll tell you the truth Bill, I had a tough pick between them drums and the trombone. Really? But when we was with Freddie and also Joe Rubin, she always had a chance to play some drums.
You would sit in front of them and do that?
